footer.blurb: Good food, delivered to your door. A modern neighbourhood restaurant in {city}.
footer.disclaimer: A fictional restaurant built as a demonstration project. Orders are simulated, reviews are illustrative, and no payments are processed.

about.heading: About {restaurant}
about.p1: We opened on Oranienstraße with a flat top, a walk-in full of vegetables, and one rule: cook everything to order, properly, and charge a fair price for it.
about.p2: Beef is ground fresh each morning and smashed to order. Bread is baked in-house. Salads are dressed when you order them, not hours before. Nothing sits under a heat lamp waiting for a courier.
about.p3: Most of what we serve travels well, which is deliberate — a burger that falls apart on the way to you is a burger we got wrong.
about.allergenBody: Every dish lists its allergens on the menu. If you need something adapted, call us before ordering and we’ll tell you honestly whether we can do it safely.
about.photographyBody: Our own photography is on its way. Until then some dishes are shown with licensed stock photographs, and these ones ask to be credited:

contact.metaDescription: Find {restaurant} in {city} — address, opening hours, phone and delivery area.
contact.heading: Contact
contact.lead: Questions about an order, an allergy, or a large booking? The fastest way to reach us is the phone — someone on the floor will pick up.

home.heroBody: Burgers, sandwiches and salads made to order. Delivery across the neighbourhood, or collect from the counter.
home.popularBody: The dishes our regulars order again and again.
home.whyLead: Made properly. Ready when you are.
home.whyFreshBody: Produce delivered every morning from Berlin suppliers we actually know. Nothing frozen, nothing reheated.
home.whyFastBody: Most orders land within 25 minutes. You'll see a realistic time before you pay, not an optimistic one.
home.whyPickupBody: Order ahead, skip the queue, collect from the counter. No fee, and you can schedule it up to six days out.
home.whyCareBody: Everything is cooked to order by chefs who take it personally. Allergens are listed on every single dish.
home.featuredLead: That’s a handful of our regulars’ favourites. Burgers, sandwiches, salads, sides, desserts and drinks are all on the full menu.
home.promoBody: Use the code below at checkout on orders over {minimum}. One per customer, because we’d like you to come back for the second one too.
home.codeSaved: Saved to your cart — it comes off at checkout.
home.testimonialQuote1: Ordered for six people on a Friday night expecting chaos. Everything arrived hot, correctly labelled, and the fries were somehow still crisp. That never happens.
home.testimonialQuote2: I use the pickup option most weeks on my way home. It's ready when the app says it will be, every time, and nobody makes me queue behind the dine-in crowd.
home.testimonialQuote3: The allergen info on every dish is the reason we keep coming back. My daughter is coeliac and this is one of the few places we order from without phoning ahead.
home.promoSaved: Saved to your cart — it comes off at checkout.
